Ubisoft Logs Strong Bookings as Players Welcome Assassin’s Creed Remake

The videogame developer is looking to get its finances back on track following a major overhaul of its operations

By

Ubisoft UBI -2.07 % decrease; down pointing triangle Entertainment reported robust net bookings for its fiscal second quarter as a remake of Assassin’s Creed fared well, a boost for the videogame developer as it seeks to get its finances back on track following a major overhaul of its operations.

The French videogame group reported 388.9 million euros ($426.9 million) in net bookings for the three months to the end of September, down nearly 21% on year, but above company guidance of around 370 million euros. An on-year decline was widely expected as analysts had forecast net bookings of 350.7 million euros, according to Visible Alpha.
